description: Hosted MCP server for SEO keyword research, search rankings, website audits, Google Search Console, Yandex Webmaster, Yandex Metrika, page content, articles and HTML artifacts.
rules: Discover the current PR-CY MCP tools before use; parameters may change between server versions.
Resolve project, search-option, keyword-group, goal, article and revision identifiers from tool responses before using them.
Batch keyword phrases in get_wordstat and get_position as a single comma-separated string.
Use format=structure in get_page_content when only metadata and headings are needed.
For article and artifact changes, use the user's requested scope and read the current blocks or revision first.
